About

Your Favourite
Fashion
Journalist.

Based in Madrid, Paula Marqués is a fashion journalist and luxury content creator whose work lives at the intersection of editorial storytelling and aspirational lifestyle. With a refined eye for aesthetics and an innate understanding of luxury culture, she crafts content that resonates deeply with audiences passionate about fashion, beauty, and the art of living well.

Her content spans professional photography, creative video, and immersive brand collaborations — always executed with the precision and elegance that define the luxury world she inhabits.
